from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
import hashlib
import subprocess

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1"
if out.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("此新候选目录已存在，禁止覆盖或重复登记")
out.mkdir()
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def ref(p):
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def save(name,d):
    (out/name).write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
parents=[
    r/"reports/research/510300_post_frozen_2026_historical_joint_sample_source_admission_v1/result.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_factor96_rapid_orders_inventory_v1/protocol.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_factor96_rapid_orders_inventory_v1/source_fields_and_anchors.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/prior_definition_review.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json",
    r/"reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet",
    r/"reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json",
    r/"research/historical_index_domestic_constraint_clock_v1.py"
]
refs=[ref(p) for p in parents]
assert refs[0]["sha256"]=="1e0e1c34e9b76cea013ad00a81cc12cad67dd5bc327ff82024852a2d07ca3ffa"
assert refs[2]["sha256"]=="75ba1786293d4b6edbbacba90a31620f433e2d41bf66f41306ff9335f84fd579"
assert refs[5]["sha256"]=="c6be6dcf35dbff5f162980115de43acc498a15c0bd116b0f003d009c7ec712e7"
assert refs[6]["sha256"]=="2edb4d5dc05c51cc64ca2c53be66af971af33ce44c88aa67cd2ddf702734eb32"
prior_queries=[
    ["rg","-n","-m","6","生产经营活动预期|经营活动预期|business_expect|activity_expect|expected_business","research","config"],
    ["rg","-n","-m","8","原材料库存|产成品库存指数|PMI.*库存","docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md","docs/PROJECT_STATE.md"]
]
searches=[]
for command in prior_queries:
    run=subprocess.run(command,cwd=r,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
    assert run.returncode in [0,1]
    searches.append({"command":command,"exit_code":run.returncode,"stdout":run.stdout,"stderr":run.stderr})
save("原经营预期问项有限旧用途核对与已见内容_E121.json",{
    "at":at,"searches":searches,
    "old_rapid_inventory_scope":"新订单减成品库存及三月差固定32账户已拒绝，不重开或重命名",
    "old_business_expectation_scope":"指定旧domestic_constraint_clock解析器含该原问项；历史背景观察已存在，不称从未见过",
    "prior_peek":"登记前曾读取原source_fields_and_anchors首2015-01记录，旧库存锚的完整同月行最后值47.4为该经营预期原量；未读取股票标签",
    "limited_review_does_not_certify_global_no_prior_use":True,
    "candidate_information_difference":"另一个直接受访经营预期原问项，不是订单减库存/采购量/工业存量的同义或计算重命名；与原实际订单/资金/融资/量价状态共同作条件信息，金融用途资格仍需来源后单独登记。",
    "different_population_does_not_mean_independent_alpha":True,
    "not_market_consensus_or_exogenous_causal_shock":True,"old_frozen_rejections_preserved":True,
    "new_price_dates_or_independence_not_claimed":True})
protocol={
    "study_id":"510300_MANUFACTURING_BUSINESS_EXPECTATION_JOINT_SOURCE_V1","experiment_id":"E121","registered_at":at,
    "status":"SOURCE_ONLY_REGISTERED_BEFORE_FULL132_CURRENT_MONTH_EXTRACTION_AND_ORIGINAL_POOL_SUPPORT",
    "hypothesis":"同样实际订单、资金与量价状态下，企业自身对经营前景的原报告预期可能不同。先检验这项不同直接问项能否完整进入原共同条件；不预设股市方向、不把期待当已兑现现金。",
    "source_scope":"固定原132份2015-01至2025-12已有官方当月PMI原文，继承唯一旧原件绑定；不采集、不用以后月表补历史、不删未知月份。",
    "source_field":"生产经营活动预期","candidate_feature":"制造业经营预期原水平",
    "new_feature_definition":"唯一原制造业其他指数当月行中的生产经营活动预期原扩散指数水平；不减订单、不自算预期差、不造趋势/窗口/分类阈值。",
    "source_clock":"原旧绑定published_at/known_at与原订单available_at逐一核同源；当前取得时点/2023搬迁URL不替代历史公开钟，首版未认证仍历史重构开发。",
    "parser_contract":"原制造业同时含采购量和在手订单表头的预期唯一列，当前月份精确原行标签对齐；重复桌面移动原量须一致，缺列/歧义/不一致UNKNOWN，不字段路径调优。",
    "scope_and_method_contract":"原方法组每月保留，不把变更企业母体当同一批企业。问项名/扩散比例不是市场共识、真实产出数量或可识别因果份额；原预期期限仅以原正文可核文字为据，否则UNKNOWN。",
    "fixed_support":"原八变量纠错模型的全部1212评分日和每一原成熟训练成员，原成员不删/换；只读idx/date/decision_time/orders_available_at/八输入，源阶段不读net_label/open/close/净值。",
    "source_admission_gate":"全部132当前原值及全部原评分/成熟成员同源时钟、原字段覆盖成立才允许另登记金融；任一未知或旧已用同金融用途实证则关闭，不另补源/改窗口救援。",
    "financial_budget":{"new_candidates":0,"new_fits":0,"new_linear_regressions":0,"new_weighted_scores":0,"new_stock_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0},
    "source_request_budget":{"queries":0,"GETs":0,"retries":0,"authenticated_requests":0},
    "labels_and_model_rule":"源通过前不读取原金融标签；即使通过也不是增量/夏普证明，后续只能另有唯一非线性方案事前登记，旧对照与冻结拒绝不救。",
    "close_rule":"固定原问项来源及必要完整支持单次实际裁决后结束资格阶段；未知保留、失败关闭、不改问项/月份/字段/钟。",
    "parents":refs,"prior_use_review":ref(out/"原经营预期问项有限旧用途核对与已见内容_E121.json"),
    "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,"new_blind_historical_sample":False,
    "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,"goal_status":"active","current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
    "prospective_forecasts":False,"orders_authorized":False,"only_executable_assets":["510300.SH","CASH_CNY"],
    "previous_goal_turn":"PROGRESS_E120_ACTUAL_PRIOR_USE_CHANGES_ACTION",
    "E120_fixed23_route_closed_and_not_reopened":True}
save("protocol_source.json",protocol)
save("源资格认领_E121.json",{"at":at,"status":"REGISTERED_NOT_YET_EXTRACTED","source_field":protocol["source_field"],
    "prototype_is_new_direct_question_not_unseen_sample_claim":True,"all132_and_original_training_pool_before_finance":True,"new_financial_fits":0})
gitstatus=subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--short","--untracked-files=no"],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip()
save("运行前git记录_E121.json",{"at":at,"branch":subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip(),
    "HEAD":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=r,text=True,encoding="utf-8").strip(),"status":gitstatus})
print(json.dumps({"E121":"只源事前登记","原件":132,"问项":protocol["source_field"],"协议SHA256":ref(out/"protocol_source.json")["sha256"],
    "新请求/金融模型/标签/账户":0,"旧E120不重开":True},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
